priority.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 13: Fermi Surges 14% on AMD Credit Support for Project Matador - The Motley Fool
priority.summary: AMD's backing of Fermi's 222 MW lease signals financing momentum for AI campus infrastructure, though full funding hurdles remain ahead, Oct. 13, 2026.

The funding backstop will help Fermi support "a lease for phase one of Fermi's Project Matador energy and AI buildout ... with 222 megawatts (MW) of gross power capacity in line with Fermi's first customer lease as announced on August 10, 2026." Fermi and AMD also agreed to a separate framework to support an expansion plan up to 650 MW.
